pairs: Mense tertio egressionis Israël de terra Ægypti,
In the third month of the departure of Israel from the land of Egypt,
in die hac venerunt in solitudinem Sinai.
in that day, they arrived in the wilderness of Sinai.
et pervenientes usque in desertum Sinai,
and going directly to the desert of Sinai,
castrametati sunt in eodem loco, ibique Israël fixit tentoria e regione montis.
they encamped in the same place, and there Israel pitched their tents away from the region of the mountain.
And the Lord called to him from the mountain,
“This you shall say to the house of Jacob,
and announce to the sons of Israel:
Vos ipsi vidistis quæ fecerim Ægyptiis,
‘You have seen what I have done to the Egyptians,
quomodo portaverim vos super alas aquilarum,
in what way I carried you upon the wings of eagles
and how I have taken you for myself.
If, therefore, you will hear my voice,
and you will keep my covenant,
eritis mihi in peculium de cunctis populis:
you will be to me a particular possession out of all people.
For all the earth is mine.
et vos eritis mihi in regnum sacerdotale,
And you will be to me a priestly kingdom
Hæc sunt verba quæ loqueris ad filios Israël.
These are the words that you will speak to the sons of Israel.”
and calling together those greater by birth among the people,
exposuit omnes sermones quos mandaverat Dominus.
he set forth all the words which the Lord had commanded.
And all the people responded together:
Cumque retulisset Moyses verba populi ad Dominum,
And when Moses had related the words of the people to the Lord,
Jam nunc veniam ad te in caligine nubis,
“Soon now, I will come to you in the mist of a cloud,
ut audiat me populus loquentem ad te,
so that the people may hear me speaking to you,
and so that they may believe you continuously.”
Nuntiavit ergo Moyses verba populi ad Dominum.
Therefore, Moses reported the words of the people to the Lord,
and let them wash their garments.
Et sint parati in diem tertium: in die enim tertia descendet Dominus coram omni plebe super montem Sinai.
And let them be prepared on the third day. For on the third day, the Lord will descend, in the sight of all the people, over Mount Sinai.
And you will establish limits for the people all around,
and you will say to them:
‘Take care not to ascend to the mountain,
and that you do not touch its parts.
but he shall be crushed with stones,
or he shall be pierced through with darts.
For when the trumpet begins to sound,
perhaps they might go up toward the mountain.”
Descenditque Moyses de monte ad populum,
And Moses came down from the mountain to the people,
And when they had washed their garments,
and do not draw near to your wives.”
Jamque advenerat tertius dies, et mane inclaruerat:
And now, the third day arrived and the morning dawned.
And behold, thunders began to be heard,
and a very dense cloud covered the mountain,
and the noise of the trumpet resounded vehemently.
et timuit populus qui erat in castris.
And the people who were in the camp were fearful.
Cumque eduxisset eos Moyses in occursum Dei de loco castrorum,
And when Moses had led them out to meet God, from the place of the camp,
they stood at the base of the mountain.
Then all of Mount Sinai was smoking.
eo quod descendisset Dominus super eum in igne:
For the Lord had descended over it with fire,
et ascenderet fumus ex eo quasi de fornace,
and smoke ascended from it, as from a furnace.
And the entire mountain was terrible.
Et sonitus buccinæ paulatim crescebat in majus,
And the sound of the trumpet gradually increased to be louder,
Descenditque Dominus super montem Sinai in ipso montis vertice,
And the Lord descended over Mount Sinai, to the very top of the mountain,
et vocavit Moysen in cacumen ejus. Quo cum ascendisset,
and he called Moses to its summit. And when he had ascended there,
and call the people to witness,
ne forte velit transcendere terminos ad videndum Dominum,
lest they might be willing to transgress the limits, so as to see the Lord,
et pereat ex eis plurima multitudo.
and a very great multitude of them might perish.
Sacerdotes quoque qui accedunt ad Dominum,
Likewise, the priests who approach toward the Lord,
And Moses said to the Lord:
Non poterit vulgus ascendere in montem Sinai:
“The people are not able to ascend to Mount Sinai.
And the Lord said to him,
sacerdotes autem et populus ne transeant terminos,
But let not the priests or the people transgress the limits,
lest perhaps he may put them to death.”
And Moses descended to the people,
and he explained everything to them.
